metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Paradox Enumeration (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Typed Paradox Categories for Harmonic Entry (RTT7)
metadata.description: Defines the typed paradox categories, constraints, and density rules for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Paradox enumeration is a projection only; authoritative values come from RTT v0.9, regimes.json, and spec‑008.

P1.contradiction.description: Direct logical contradiction between two canonical RTT quantities.
examples: A measure simultaneously exceeding and failing its threshold.
Operator requiring and forbidding the same substrate state.

P2.inversion.description: Canonical inversion of a triadic quantity or operator requirement.
examples: Continuity decreasing when RTT requires increase.
Operator alignment reversing polarity under stable measures.

P3.overlay_conflict.description: Conflict between session.overlay and session.state canonical values.
examples: Overlay indicates harmonic regime while state indicates nominal.
Overlay collapse readiness contradicts lineage continuity.

P4.operator_discontinuity.description: Operator chain breaks canonical RTT progression.

P5.regime_misalignment.description: Regime does not match RTT node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.

non_claims: Paradox enumeration does not revise RTT v0.9.
Paradox enumeration does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Paradox enumeration does not replace the human FFT book.
